mentions.name: Blackboat Real Estate Research
mentions.description: This tool turns real-estate research into a one-click affair: an agent automatically assesses a location and neighborhood, scores amenities, and gets an average price range for similar homes. It generates research reports for consumers, and realtors can have on-demand reports generated with up-to-date information. Planned future features include passive tracking of an existing real-estate portfolio with notifications of local events or litigations that may affect property pricing.
mentions.problem: Managing a real-estate portfolio and getting unbiased pricing estimates for new locations is tedious; doing one's own research on a location takes hours.
mentions.audience: Managing a real-estate portfolio and getting unbiased pricing estimates for new locations is tedious; doing one's own research on a location takes hours.
